name: Clear Captions
desc:
Client Care Specialist | $19.00 - $20.00/hr | Phone, Chat, and Email, Serving Seniors with Hearing Loss
Company: ClearCaptions
Industry: Telecommunications | Phone Captioning Services for the Hard-of-Hearing
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 ClearCaptions is an FCC-certified telephone captioning provider that helps people with hearing loss, mostly seniors, follow phone conversations by displaying real-time captions of what the caller is saying. This role has you supporting those customers directly across phone, chat, and email, helping with new installations, product training, account maintenance, and general questions about the service.
This is genuinely relationship-driven, patient-focused work rather than a rush-through-calls environment. You're expected to simplify technical concepts for customers who may not be tech-savvy, respond to frustration with empathy, and take real ownership of an issue from first contact through resolution rather than passing people along. All customer interactions are documented in Salesforce, and you'll be measured on service level, first call resolution, and customer satisfaction metrics.
assessment: expect an assessment. this is a heavy chat role
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: High school diploma or equivalent.
 Required Experience: Minimum 2 years of customer service experience.
 Preferred Experience: Strong working knowledge of Salesforce or another CRM. Basic telephone technology familiarity.
 Required Skills:
Genuine desire to help customers feel supported and heard, adapting pace and style to their needs
Strong listening skills with ability to identify needs and recommend solutions
Ability to balance empathy with time management
Comfort with Microsoft Office and virtual team tools (Teams, Slack)
Discretion and sound decision-making, maintaining confidentiality
Willingness to work flexible schedules, including evenings and weekends
Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
Someone with 2+ years of customer service experience who is naturally patient and enjoys building real rapport, especially with senior customers
Participants who prefer relationship-based problem solving over fast, transactional calls
Anyone comfortable with occasional evening or weekend shifts
People who want a mission-driven company (accessibility/hearing loss services) behind their day-to-day work
Not a Good Fit for:
Participants without at least 2 years of customer service experience
Someone who prefers rushing through calls quickly rather than taking time with each customer
Anyone unable to communicate clearly by phone with individuals who have hearing loss, this is listed as a primary function requirement
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Customer service
Senior/accessibility services
Salesforce CRM
Technical support (basic)
Empathetic communication
Account management
Product training
Multi-channel support (phone, chat, email)
Customer retention
Problem resolution
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
 Per the posting directly: applications are personally reviewed by ClearCaptions' talent acquisition team (not automated screening), and applicants can expect to hear back if there's a potential fit, with next steps outlined at that point.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell me about a time you helped a customer who was frustrated or struggling with technology, and how you approached it with patience.
How do you balance taking the time someone needs with meeting performance metrics like first call resolution?
Describe your experience with Salesforce or another CRM system.
How do you communicate clearly with someone who has hearing loss or difficulty understanding you over the phone?
What does working with a primarily senior customer base mean to you, and why does it interest you?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $19.00-$20.00/hr, determined by competitive market analysis and internal equity, final offer based on qualifications and experience.
Shift: Full-time, 100% remote. Flexible scheduling required, including evenings and weekends as needed.
Benefits: Premium medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) match, fitness program, professional development stipend, home office allowance. Full details available at clearcaptions.com/careers.
Equipment Provided: Company-provided or approved headset required to maintain audio quality; other equipment details not specified in posting.
Felony Friendly?: Not stated in posting or found in outside research specific to ClearCaptions.
Drug Test: Not stated in posting.
Notes: This posting includes a direct fraud/scam warning: all legitimate openings are posted exclusively on ClearCaptions' own careers page, recruiters only contact from verified @clearcaptions.com addresses, and they will never offer a job through LinkedIn messages, social media, or ask for banking/SSN information early in the process. Worth passing along to participants as a scam-awareness reminder. No state hiring restrictions were found in any version of this posting, appears broadly open nationwide including Oklahoma.
Career Pathway: Client Care Specialist → Senior Client Care Specialist → Team Lead → CEX Operations Supervisor → Customer Experience Manager
training: Training Schedule: Mon-Fri, 9:00am-5:30pm CST. Training is first two weeks of employment.
